title: Scandinavia Group Tour: Helsinki to Copenhagen
alt: The Stockholm waterfront and Gamla Stan seen from the Skyview gondola
transport: Overnight cruises Helsinki to Stockholm and Oslo to Copenhagen, a flight to Bergen, the Norway in a Nutshell route and coach to Geilo and Oslo

expert.name: Aino
expert.quote: Lapland in winter is quieter than anywhere I know. The snow swallows every sound and the sky does the rest.
expert.tip: Rent the thermal overalls your lodge offers for the aurora nights. Your own jacket will not be enough at minus twenty, however good it looks.

summary: Nine days through four Nordic capitals as a small group: Helsinki, an overnight cruise to Stockholm with the Skyview gondola, Bergen and the Norway in a Nutshell route to Geilo, Oslo, and a cruise to Copenhagen.
included: Included: all transfers and rail or ferry journeys as listed; sightseeing and cruises as listed with tickets where stated; daily breakfast.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees; lunches and dinners unless stated; travel insurance; optional excursions; personal expenses. Hotels are quoted as a class and named on confirmation.
